  const body=rows.length?rows.map(row=>`<div class="today-duty-person ${String(row.teacher||'').trim()===currentLoginTeacherName()?'mine':''}"><strong>${escapeHtml(row.teacher||'-')}</strong><span>${escapeHtml(row.place||'면학관 2~3층')}</span><small>${escapeHtml([row.start,row.end].filter(Boolean).join('~'))}</small></div>`).join(''):`<div class="night-supervisor-empty"><i>◇</i><b>오늘 야자감독이 없습니다</b><span>43_야자감독계획의 오늘 날짜가 비어 있습니다.</span></div>`;
  $("#drawerBody").innerHTML=`<div class="today-duty-list"><time>${escapeHtml(key)}</time>${body}</div><div class="drawer-actions"><button class="btn primary" data-reference="night-supervisor">빠른열기 · 야자감독 전체 보기</button></div>`;
  $("#drawer").classList.remove("hidden");$("#drawerBackdrop").classList.remove("hidden");
  $("#drawerBody [data-reference='night-supervisor']")?.addEventListener("click",()=>openReferenceDrawer("night-supervisor"));
}

function timetableClassColorKey(room){
  const match=String(room||"").match(/(?:^|\b)([123])-?(\d{1,2})(?:\b|$)/);
  if(!match)return "";
  return `${match[1]}-${Number(match[2])}`;
}
function timetableClassColorClass(room){
  const key=timetableClassColorKey(room);
  if(!key)return "";
  let hash=0; for(const ch of key)hash=(hash*31+ch.charCodeAt(0))>>>0;
  return `class-color-${hash%9}`;
}


let dashboardTimetableMode="";
let studentTimetableSelectedId="";
function dashboardTimetableAutoMode(){
  if(dashboardTimetableMode)return dashboardTimetableMode;
  const now=new Date(),minute=now.getHours()*60+now.getMinutes();
  const end=(now.getDay()===3)?(14*60+30):(16*60+30);
  return minute>=end?"night":"day";
}

  return timetableMasterWeekDates(dashboardWeekDate||dateKey(new Date()));
}
function dashboardNightAttendanceRows(dayKey,slot){
  return (readonlyCache?.nightAttendance||readonlyCache?.attendance||[]).filter(row=>{
    const key=String(row.date||row.day||"").slice(0,10);
    return key===dayKey&&nightSlotName(row)===slot&&nightRecordIsAttendance(row);
  });
}
function dashboardAfterProgramsForDay(dayKey){
  // 일정 표시는 강좌 마스터가 아니라 실제 차시만 사용한다.
  // afterSchoolProgramGroups()가 12_차시일정/실제 일정과 과거 출결 fallback을 단일화한다.
  const canonical=typeof afterSchoolProgramGroups==="function"?afterSchoolProgramGroups():[];
  const seen=new Set();
  return canonical.filter(program=>{
    if(!program||program.kind!=="after"||program.isCourseMaster) return false;
    const pday=String(program.date||program.sessionDate||program.operationDate||"").slice(0,10);
    if(pday!==dayKey||!programHasNightStudyImpact(program)||/취소|휴강|결강|폐강|미운영/.test(String(program.status||program.operationState||program.sessionStatus||""))) return false;
    const session=String(program.sessionId||"").trim();
    const course=String(program.courseId||program.programId||program.id||"").replace(/^after-(?:course|master|session)-/,"").trim();
    const slot=typeof dashboardProgramNightSlot==="function"?dashboardProgramNightSlot(program):String(program.time||"");
    const title=String(program.actualTitle||program.title||program.type||"").replace(/\s/g,"").trim();
    const key=session?`session|${session}`:[course,pday,slot,title].join("|");
    if(seen.has(key)) return false;
    seen.add(key);
    return true;
  });
}
function dashboardProgramNightSlot(program){
  const text=`${program.afterType||""} ${program.type||""} ${program.title||""} ${program.time||""}`;
  if(/야간심화/.test(text)){
    const m=String(program.time||"").match(/(\d{1,2}):(\d{2})/); const minute=m?Number(m[1])*60+Number(m[2]):0;
    return minute>=20*60+20?"야자2":"야자1";
  }
  return "오후자습";
}
function dashboardNightWeekMarkup(){
  const dates=dashboardNightWeekDates(),days=["월","화","수","목","금"],slots=[
    {key:"오후자습",label:"오후자습",time:schoolHourRange("오후자습")||"17:00~18:00"},
    {key:"야자1",label:"야자1",time:schoolHourRange("야자1")||"19:00~20:10"},
    {key:"야자2",label:"야자2",time:schoolHourRange("야자2")||"20:20~21:30"}
  ];
  const cells=[];
  slots.forEach(slot=>{
    cells.push(`<div class="dashboard-night-period"><b>${escapeHtml(slot.label)}</b><small>${escapeHtml(slot.time)}</small></div>`);
    dates.forEach((date,i)=>{
      const key=dateKey(date),isWed=i===2,holiday=attendanceIsSchoolHoliday(key);
      if(holiday){cells.push(`<div class="dashboard-night-cell closed holiday"><b>미운영</b><small>공휴일</small></div>`);return;}
      if(isWed){cells.push(`<div class="dashboard-night-cell closed"><b>-</b><small>야간 미운영</small></div>`);return;}
      const rows=dashboardNightAttendanceRows(key,slot.key),students=new Set(rows.map(attendanceStudentKey).filter(Boolean));
      const programs=dashboardAfterProgramsForDay(key).filter(p=>dashboardProgramNightSlot(p)===slot.key);
      const programCards=programs.map(p=>`<button class="dashboard-night-program-chip" data-dashboard-night-program="${escapeHtml(p.id||p.programId||"")}" data-dashboard-night-program-day="${key}"><b>${/야간심화/.test(`${p.afterType||""} ${p.title||""}`)?"야간심화":"방과후"}</b><span>${escapeHtml(p.actualTitle||p.title||"프로그램")}</span></button>`).join("");
      cells.push(`<div class="dashboard-night-cell ${students.size||programs.length?'active':'empty'}"><button class="dashboard-night-roster" data-dashboard-night-day="${key}" data-dashboard-night-slot="${escapeHtml(slot.key)}"><b>${students.size?`${students.size}명`:'-'}</b><small>${students.size?'자습인원 보기':'자습 자료 없음'}</small></button>${programCards}</div>`);
    });
  });
  return `<div class="dashboard-night-week"><div class="dashboard-night-corner">시간대</div>${days.map((d,i)=>`<div class="dashboard-night-head"><b>${d}</b><small>${dates[i]?`${dates[i].getMonth()+1}/${dates[i].getDate()}`:""}</small></div>`).join("")}${cells.join("")}</div>`;
}

function noticeExpectedCount(item){
  const target=String(item?.targetClass||"전체");
  if(!target||target==="전체"||/전체|1~9|1-9/.test(target))return 9;
  const nums=[...new Set((target.match(/\d+/g)||[]).map(Number).filter(n=>n>=1&&n<=9))];
  return Math.max(1,nums.length||1);
}
function noticeDeadlineTypeLabel(type){
  const value=String(type||'').trim();
  return value==='학생제출'?'학생 제출':value==='담임확인'?'담임 확인':value==='업무처리'?'업무 처리':'마감';
}
function noticeDeadlineStatus(item){
  if(!item?.deadline)return '';
  const raw=String(item.deadline);
  const days=daysFromToday(raw);
  const prefix=noticeDeadlineTypeLabel(item.deadlineType);
  const timeMatch=raw.match(/T(\d{2}):(\d{2})/);
  const timeLabel=timeMatch?(()=>{const h=Number(timeMatch[1]),m=timeMatch[2];return `${h<12?'오전':'오후'} ${h%12||12}:${m}`;})():'';
  if(days==null)return [prefix,timeLabel].filter(Boolean).join(' · ');
  if(days<0)return `${prefix} · D+${Math.abs(days)}${timeLabel?` · ${timeLabel}`:''}`;
  if(days===0)return `${prefix} · 오늘${timeLabel?` ${timeLabel}`:''}`;
  if(days===1)return `${prefix} · 내일${timeLabel?` ${timeLabel}`:''}`;
  const md=raw.slice(5,10).replace('-','/');
  return `${prefix} · ${md}${timeLabel?` ${timeLabel}`:''}`;
}

}

}
function automaticDeadlineAlerts(options={}){
  const result=[], seen=new Set(), todayKey=dateKey(today);
  const push=(item)=>{if(!item?.due)return;const d=daysFromToday(item.due);if(d==null)return;if(!options.includePast&&d<0)return;if(!options.includeFar&&d>30)return;const key=`${item.source}:${item.id}:${item.due}`;if(seen.has(key))return;seen.add(key);result.push({...item,days:d});};
  (readonlyCache?.programs||[]).forEach(program=>{
    if(!program||program.isCourseMaster)return;
    const title=program.actualTitle||program.title||"프로그램";
    const operationDate=String(program.date||program.endDate||"").slice(0,10);
    if(operationDate&&program.kind==="selected")push({id:program.id,source:"program",category:"선택활동",title:`${title} 운영`,due:operationDate,meta:[program.time,program.place].filter(Boolean).join(" · ")});
    if(program.reportRequired&&program.reportDeadline)push({id:`${program.id}:student-report`,source:"report",category:"보고서",title:`${title} 학생 보고서 마감`,due:String(program.reportDeadline).slice(0,10),meta:"학생 보고서"});
    if(program.reportToAuthority&&Number(program.reportAfterDays||0)>0&&operationDate)push({id:`${program.id}:agency`,source:"agency",category:"기관보고",title:`${title} 기관보고 마감`,due:addDaysKey(program.endDate||operationDate,program.reportAfterDays),meta:program.reportAgency||"기관보고"});
  });
  (Array.isArray(state.reportDeadlines)?state.reportDeadlines:[]).forEach(item=>push({id:item.id||item.title,source:"report",category:"보고서",title:item.title||"학생 보고서 마감",due:item.due||item.date,meta:item.className||"보고서"}));
  (Array.isArray(state.schoolDeadlines)?state.schoolDeadlines:[]).filter(item=>!item.done&&item.status!=="완료").forEach(item=>push({id:item.id,source:"school",category:"업무마감",title:item.title||"학교업무 마감",due:item.due||item.date,meta:item.department||"학교업무"}));
  return result.filter(item=>(options.includeDismissed||!autoNoticeIsDismissed(item.source,item.id))&&(options.includeUnapproved||autoNoticeVisibleAfterGovernance(item))).sort((a,b)=>a.days-b.days||String(a.title).localeCompare(String(b.title)));
}
function deadlineBadge(item){
  if(item.days<0)return `D+${Math.abs(item.days)}`; if(item.days===0)return "오늘"; if(item.days===1)return "내일"; return `D-${item.days}`;
}
function automaticDeadlineMarkup(limit=20){
  const rows=automaticDeadlineAlerts({includePast:true}).filter(item=>item.days>=-7&&item.days<=30).slice(0,limit);
  if(!rows.length)return '<div class="work-empty"><b>현재 자동 마감공지가 없습니다.</b><small>프로그램 운영일·보고서·기관보고·학교업무 마감을 자동 계산해 표시합니다.</small></div>';
  return rows.map(item=>`<button class="work-auto-deadline ${item.days<0?'overdue':item.days<=1?'urgent':''}" data-auto-deadline-source="${escapeHtml(item.source)}" data-auto-deadline-id="${escapeHtml(String(item.id||''))}"><i>${escapeHtml(item.category)}</i><span><b>${escapeHtml(item.title)}</b><small>${escapeHtml(item.due)} · ${escapeHtml(item.meta||'')}</small></span><em>${deadlineBadge(item)}</em></button>`).join('');
}
function automaticDeadlineAdminReviewMarkup(limit=40){
  if(!currentUserCanManageNotices())return automaticDeadlineMarkup(limit);
  const rows=automaticDeadlineAlerts({includePast:true,includeDismissed:true,includeUnapproved:true}).filter(item=>item.days>=-7&&item.days<=30).slice(0,limit);
  if(!rows.length)return '<div class="work-empty"><b>검토할 자동공지 후보가 없습니다.</b></div>';
  const label=status=>status==='approved'?'승인':status==='handled'?'확인':status==='blocked'?'불가(해제)':'검토대기';
  return rows.map(item=>{const status=autoNoticeGovernanceStatus(item.source,item.id);return `<button class="work-auto-deadline admin-review ${status}" data-auto-deadline-source="${escapeHtml(item.source)}" data-auto-deadline-id="${escapeHtml(String(item.id||''))}"><i>${escapeHtml(item.category)}</i><span><b>${escapeHtml(item.title)}</b><small>${escapeHtml(item.due)} · ${escapeHtml(item.meta||'')} · ${label(status)}</small></span><em>${deadlineBadge(item)}</em></button>`;}).join('');
}

function noticeDeadlineStatus(item){
  if(!item?.deadline)return '';
  const raw=String(item.deadline);
  const days=daysFromToday(raw);
  const prefix=noticeDeadlineTypeLabel(item.deadlineType);
  const timeMatch=raw.match(/T(\d{2}):(\d{2})/);
  const timeLabel=timeMatch?(()=>{const h=Number(timeMatch[1]),m=timeMatch[2];return `${h<12?'오전':'오후'} ${h%12||12}:${m}`;})():'';
  if(days==null)return [prefix,timeLabel].filter(Boolean).join(' · ');
  if(days<0)return `${prefix} · D+${Math.abs(days)}${timeLabel?` · ${timeLabel}`:''}`;
  if(days===0)return `${prefix} · 오늘${timeLabel?` ${timeLabel}`:''}`;
  if(days===1)return `${prefix} · 내일${timeLabel?` ${timeLabel}`:''}`;
  const md=raw.slice(5,10).replace('-','/');
  return `${prefix} · ${md}${timeLabel?` ${timeLabel}`:''}`;
}

    const operationDate=String(program.date||program.endDate||"").slice(0,10);

    if(program.reportRequired&&program.reportDeadline)push({id:`${program.id}:student-report`,source:"report",category:"보고서",title:`${title} 학생 보고서 마감`,due:String(program.reportDeadline).slice(0,10),meta:"학생 보고서"});
    if(program.reportToAuthority&&Number(program.reportAfterDays||0)>0&&operationDate)push({id:`${program.id}:agency`,source:"agency",category:"기관보고",title:`${title} 기관보고 마감`,due:addDaysKey(program.endDate||operationDate,program.reportAfterDays),meta:program.reportAgency||"기관보고"});
  });

function deadlineBadge(item){
  if(item.days<0)return `D+${Math.abs(item.days)}`; if(item.days===0)return "오늘"; if(item.days===1)return "내일"; return `D-${item.days}`;
}
function automaticDeadlineMarkup(limit=20){

}

  return rows.map(item=>`<button class="work-auto-deadline ${item.days<0?'overdue':item.days<=1?'urgent':''}" data-auto-deadline-source="${escapeHtml(item.source)}" data-auto-deadline-id="${escapeHtml(String(item.id||''))}"><i>${escapeHtml(item.category)}</i><span><b>${escapeHtml(item.title)}</b><small>${escapeHtml(item.due)} · ${escapeHtml(item.meta||'')}</small></span><em>${deadlineBadge(item)}</em></button>`).join('');
}
function automaticDeadlineAdminReviewMarkup(limit=40){

function uniqueActiveAlertStudents(rows=[]){
  const students=readonlyCache?.students||[];
  const validIds=new Set(students.map(s=>String(s.id||s.studentId||'').trim()).filter(Boolean));
  const validNos=new Set(students.map(s=>String(s.studentNo||s.number||'').trim()).filter(Boolean));
  const seen=new Set(),out=[];
  for(const row of rows){
    const id=String(row?.studentId||row?.id||'').trim(),no=String(row?.studentNo||row?.number||'').trim();
    const hasKnownIdentity=(id&&validIds.has(id))||(no&&validNos.has(no));
    if((validIds.size||validNos.size)&&!hasKnownIdentity)continue;
    const key=(id&&validIds.has(id)?id:'')||(no&&validNos.has(no)?no:'')||`${row?.classNo||row?.classLabel||''}|${row?.name||''}`;
    if(!key||seen.has(key))continue;seen.add(key);out.push(row);
  }
  return out;
}

function timetableClassColorKey(room){
  const match=String(room||"").match(/(?:^|\b)([123])-?(\d{1,2})(?:\b|$)/);
  if(!match)return "";
  return `${match[1]}-${Number(match[2])}`;
}
function timetableClassColorClass(room){
  const key=timetableClassColorKey(room);
  if(!key)return "";
  let hash=0; for(const ch of key)hash=(hash*31+ch.charCodeAt(0))>>>0;
  return `class-color-${hash%9}`;
}

function dashboardTimetableAutoMode(){
  if(dashboardTimetableMode)return dashboardTimetableMode;
  const now=new Date(),minute=now.getHours()*60+now.getMinutes();
  const end=(now.getDay()===3)?(14*60+30):(16*60+30);
  return minute>=end?"night":"day";
}

function dashboardAfterProgramsForDay(dayKey){
  // 일정 표시는 강좌 마스터가 아니라 실제 차시만 사용한다.
  // afterSchoolProgramGroups()가 12_차시일정/실제 일정과 과거 출결 fallback을 단일화한다.
  const canonical=typeof afterSchoolProgramGroups==="function"?afterSchoolProgramGroups():[];
  const seen=new Set();
  return canonical.filter(program=>{
    if(!program||program.kind!=="after"||program.isCourseMaster) return false;
    const pday=String(program.date||program.sessionDate||program.operationDate||"").slice(0,10);
    if(pday!==dayKey||!programHasNightStudyImpact(program)||/취소|휴강|결강|폐강|미운영/.test(String(program.status||program.operationState||program.sessionStatus||""))) return false;
    const session=String(program.sessionId||"").trim();
    const course=String(program.courseId||program.programId||program.id||"").replace(/^after-(?:course|master|session)-/,"").trim();
    const slot=typeof dashboardProgramNightSlot==="function"?dashboardProgramNightSlot(program):String(program.time||"");
    const title=String(program.actualTitle||program.title||program.type||"").replace(/\s/g,"").trim();
    const key=session?`session|${session}`:[course,pday,slot,title].join("|");
    if(seen.has(key)) return false;
    seen.add(key);
    return true;
  });
}
function dashboardProgramNightSlot(program){
  const text=`${program.afterType||""} ${program.type||""} ${program.title||""} ${program.time||""}`;
  if(/야간심화/.test(text)){
    const m=String(program.time||"").match(/(\d{1,2}):(\d{2})/); const minute=m?Number(m[1])*60+Number(m[2]):0;
    return minute>=20*60+20?"야자2":"야자1";
  }
  return "오후자습";
}

  const formatReportDateTime = value => {
    if (value === null || value === undefined || value === "") return "";
    const raw = String(value).trim();
    const serial = Number(raw);
    let date = null;
    if (Number.isFinite(serial) && serial > 20000 && serial < 100000) {
      // Google Sheets / Excel serial date: 1899-12-30 base.
      date = new Date(Date.UTC(1899, 11, 30) + serial * 86400000);
    } else {
      const normalized = raw
        .replace(/\./g, "-")
        .replace(/오전/g, "AM")
        .replace(/오후/g, "PM")
        .replace(/\s+/g, " ")
        .trim();
      const parsed = Date.parse(normalized);
      if (Number.isFinite(parsed)) date = new Date(parsed);
    }
    if (!date || Number.isNaN(date.getTime())) return raw;
    const parts = new Intl.DateTimeFormat("ko-KR", {
      timeZone: "Asia/Seoul", year: "numeric", month: "2-digit", day: "2-digit",
      hour: "2-digit", minute: "2-digit", hour12: false
    }).formatToParts(date);
    const part = type => parts.find(x => x.type === type)?.value || "";
    return `${part("year")}-${part("month")}-${part("day")} ${part("hour")}:${part("minute")}`;
